name: DJI Matrice 4TD (SP Plus+)
description: An IP55-rated, all-weather thermal drone with a 48MP multi-sensor camera, infrared thermal imaging, and an 1800m laser rangefinder. Powered by AI, it is built for public safety, search and rescue, and night operations .

name: DJI Matrice 4D (SP Plus+)
description: A high-precision, IP55-rated mapping drone with a 4/3 CMOS mechanical-shutter camera and 1800m laser rangefinder for professional surveying and construction.

name: DJI Dock 3 (Overseas Edition)
description: A next-generation drone-in-a-box solution for automated, remote operations. Enables rapid deployment and data acquisition without on-site pilots.

name: DJI Matrice 400
description: Enterprise drone  up to 59 min flight, 6 kg payload. LiDAR, mmWave radar, thermal imaging, and advanced sensing for safe inspections and mapping.

name: DJI Mavic 3 Multispectral
description: Professional multispectral drone for precision agriculture, featuring a 20MP RGB camera and 4-band multispectral sensors (G/R/RE/NIR), RTK module, and up to 43 minutes of flight time. Built with omnidirectional obstacle avoidance and DJI O3 Industry Edition transmission.
inTheBox: DJI RC Pro Enterprise Edition Remote Controller
DJI Mavic 3 Series Intelligent Flight Battery

specifications.RTK Accuracy: Horizontal: 1 cm + 1 ppm; Vertical: 1.5 cm + 1 ppm

name: DJI Matrice 30T
description: Enterprise-grade rugged quadrotor with integrated zoom, wide-angle, thermal, and FPV cameras plus a built-in laser rangefinder. IP55 rated for all-weather operations with up to 41 minutes of flight time and RTK centimeter-level positioning.

name: Zenmuse H30T
description: An all-weather multi-sensor flagship payload that builds on the H30 by adding a powerful infrared thermal camera. Ideal for firefighting, search and rescue, and energy inspection where thermal imaging and high-temperature measurement are critical .
keyFeatures: Full-color night vision with NIR auxiliary light

name: Zenmuse H30
description: An all-weather multi-sensor flagship payload that integrates a wide-angle camera, zoom camera, laser rangefinder, and NIR auxiliary light. Designed to transcend the limits of day and night vision for public safety, emergency response, and infrastructure inspection missions .
keyFeatures: Full-color night vision with NIR auxiliary light

name: Zenmuse L3
description: A next-generation long-range, high-accuracy aerial Li DAR system featuring a 1535nm Li DAR and dual 100MP RGB mapping cameras for advanced geospatial operations .

name: Zenmuse P1
description: A full-frame, high-precision photogrammetry camera with a 45 MP sensor. Delivers excellent performance for detailed inspection and 3D modeling missions.

name: Zenmuse L2
description: A high-precision aerial LiDAR system integrating a frame LiDAR, high-accuracy IMU, and a 4/3 CMOS mapping camera. Delivers efficient and reliable geospatial data acquisition for 3D mapping .

name: DJI Zenmuse V1 Speaker
description: DJI's first drone-mounted speaker payload. Delivers 127 dB SPL at 1 m with an effective broadcast distance of 500 m. Supports multiple broadcast modes, ideal for public safety, emergency rescue, and crowd management operations.

specifications.Compatible Aircraft: Matrice 350 RTK; Matrice 300 RTK (requires DJI RC Plus)

keyFeatures: Max Sound Pressure Level: 127 dB @ 1 m

name: DJI Zenmuse S1 Spotlight
description: DJI's first LEP (Laser Excited Phosphor) drone spotlight. Provides 35 lux central illuminance at 100 m and 500 m effective range. Supports multiple lighting modes for nighttime public safety, inspection, and emergency operations.

specifications.Compatible Aircraft: Matrice 350 RTK; Matrice 300 RTK (requires DJI RC Plus)

keyFeatures: Max Central Illuminance: 35 lux @ 100 m (Both On mode)

name: TB65 Intelligent Flight Battery
description: High-capacity 263.2 Wh intelligent flight battery with self-heating at low temperatures and fast-charge support. Two batteries charge fully in approximately 60 minutes at 220V.
imagePath: media/products-images/14. DJI TB65 Intelligent Flight Battery.jpg

name: BS65 Intelligent Battery Station
description: Fleet charging and storage station for up to 8 × TB65 and 4 × WB37 batteries. Delivers up to 992W output at 220–240V for rapid multi-battery turnaround in field deployments.

name: WB37 Intelligent Battery
compatibility: DJI RC Plus / CrystalSky / D-RTK 2 and more
description: Compact 2S 4920 mAh intelligent battery with excellent low-temperature discharge performance and fast-charge support. Used in remote controllers, monitors, and accessories.

name: TB30 Intelligent Flight Battery
description: Self-heating intelligent battery rated for 400 charge cycles. Supports Hot Module Replacement to save time during critical tasks without powering down the aircraft.

name: DJI Mavic 3 Intelligent Flight Battery
description: Dedicated LiPo 4S battery for the Mavic 3 Multispectral delivering up to 43 minutes of flight time.

name: DJI Mavic 3 Battery Charging Hub
description: 100W charging hub that charges up to 3 Mavic 3 batteries in rotation, with USB-C input.

name: M400 2510F Propeller
description: Durable high-performance propellers engineered for stable flight and enhanced reliability on the DJI Matrice 400, even in demanding industrial and environmental conditions.

name: Matrice 400 Third Gimbal Connector
description: OEM DJI accessory enabling a third stabilized payload to be mounted under the Matrice 400. Supports up to 6 kg (secured) or 3 kg (quick-release). Compact and lightweight for professional multi-sensor missions.

name: DJI Dock 3 Vehicle-Mounted Gimbal Mount
description: Specialized accessory that securely holds the aircraft and gimbal during vehicle transport. Prevents impact damage on rough terrain, maintains gimbal alignment, and enables rapid mission readiness from a mobile deployment platform.

specifications.Use Case: Vehicle-mounted transport and rapid drone deployment
specifications.Key Features: Impact protection, gimbal securing, vibration reduction

name: DJI RC Plus 2 Strap & Stand Kit
description: Ergonomic strap-and-bracket system that holds the RC Plus 2 controller, freeing both of the operator's hands for focused, comfortable flight operations during extended missions.

description: Precision surveying kit including a self-locking height-adjustable pole (125–200 cm) and a dual-lock tripod. Designed to work seamlessly with the D-RTK 3 Multifunctional Station in both base station and rover modes.

Functions as a base station for centimeter-level positioning of multiple drones simultaneously, a relay station to extend drone range, or a rover station for ground control point collection.
